comment: Seventy of this module's jacks are on the panel and are never read: everything except the eight pitch jacks, the eight frequency modulation jacks and the eight gate jacks. Parameter 8 and input 16 belong to the first voice's phase modulation, which the chip does not define, and neither is given a widget. The panel title says under development and the module is the only one in the plugin with no panel lettering.
